name: cached-table-identity
main:
local a=require("mod")
local b=require("mod")
assert(a==b)
print("ok")

name: first-return-only
main:
local a,b=require("mod")
assert(a==42 and b==nil)
print("ok")

name: returned-function-sandbox
main:
caller_marker=99
local f=require("mod")
assert(f()==42 and module_marker==nil)
print("ok")

files.mod.luau:
module_marker=42
return function()
assert(caller_marker==nil)
return module_marker
end

name: errors-propagate-and-retry
main:
local ok,e=pcall(function() return require("mod") end)
assert(not ok and string.find(e,"owned-module-error",1,true))
local again=pcall(function() return require("mod") end)
assert(not again)
print("ok")

name: yield-rejected
main:
local ok,e=pcall(function() return require("mod") end)
assert(not ok and string.find(e,"attempt to yield from sandboxed require",1,true))
print("ok")

name: empty-module-refused-upstream
finding: The upstream include processor treats an empty regular module as a failed read; standalone inspection accepts the empty source.

name: local-require-preserved-by-inspection
main:
local function require(x) return x end
print(require("missing"))
finding: The upstream lexer processes a locally shadowed require as a source directive. Standalone AST inspection preserves lexical binding and the unprocessed source runs correctly.

name: dynamic-call-corrupted-upstream
finding: The upstream preprocessor reports success after deleting a dynamic require prefix and produces invalid Luau. Standalone inspection diagnoses the unsupported dynamic call.

name: comments-and-literal-strings
main:
-- require("missing")
--[=[ require("also_missing") ]=]
local s=[=[require("still_missing")]=]
local v=require("mod")
print(v)

name: source-map-module-and-caller
finding: The generated module error maps to the correct module line, but the main require call maps into the module after a missing-space --@line reset.

name: source-macros-disabled
finding: The preprocessor package does not install the guide's predefined macros by default. The editor's ScriptSync supplies them only when its SLua constants option is enabled.
